base.description: The basic texture for this composite texture

alpha.description: Can be used to modify the opacity of the texture. 255 is fully opaque, 0 is fully transparent.

alternates.description: The texture may consists of any amount of alternatives, one of which will be randomly chosen when the block is placed in the world.

blendedOverlays.description: A set of textures to overlay above this texture. The base texture may be overlayed with any quantity of textures. These are baked together during texture atlas creation.

rotation.description: Rotation of the texture may only be a multiple of 90

tiles.description:
A way of basic support for connected textures. Textures should be named numerically from 1 to TilesWidth squared. E.g., if TilesWidth is 3, the order follows the pattern of:
1 2 3
4 5 6
7 8 9

tilesWidth.description: The number of tiles in one direction that make up the full connected textures defined in Tiles.
